correctness.rationale: The displayed coordinate model has exactly twenty distinct vertices. There is a precise restriction to vertex-supported tetrahedra; any continuous global maximum argument is separate and does not imply a continuous runner-up.

No inspected source entails the complete eleven-level histogram or the edge-signature characterization. Publication priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The classical ten largest inscribed regular tetrahedra supply a natural benchmark. The exactly 120 next-largest vertex tetrahedra and the strict algebraic gap quantify discrete near-extremality, with a distinctive six-edge shape classification; the entire eleven-class volume distribution is a natural exact invariant of a canonical regular solid. Unlike an arbitrary finite slice, this addresses all vertex-supported tetrahedra of the named object and has a clear reason for the precise second shell. No continuous extremal extension is asserted.
